name: ldionmarcil
biography: Louis is a Security Analyst working at GoSecure in Montreal where he specializes in offensive appsec and pentest on medium to large scale organizations. Seasoned CTF participant and sometimes finalist with the DCIETS team, he has also written challenges for various competitions. Having recently obtained his Software Engineering degree, he dabbles in various research engagements between pentests. @ldionmarcil
